cpu_limit: Two logical CPUs on separate physical cores, quota of two CPUs. Services ran sequentially in separate network-isolated containers without a GPU device.

voices.kokoro: Kokoro-82M v1.0 FP32, en-US, ray-kanon-en-v1, CPUExecutionProvider, two intra-op threads, one inter-op thread
voices.kanon: AivisSpeech Engine 1.2.0, Kanon 1.0.0 Normal, style 1325133120, CPU mode

timing: Monotonic client time from start of first local request to last byte of complete WAV. Kanon includes audio_query and synthesis. Outputs are 24000 Hz mono PCM16. Models were warmed with a separate phrase. Each request contains one whole passage.
gpu_reference: Earlier warm runs on the same host and text. Kokoro used one socket request per text with a 4.25 GiB CUDA arena ceiling. Kanon used five HTTP loopback runs with default speech timing.
